Requirement Rule: Required course; complete this course.

Name: Calculus II

Name: Introduction to Linear Algebra

Subject: MATH
Name: Applied Linear Algebra

Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Name: Combinatorics

Degree Attributes: Sac State BS Computer Science - Math/Logic Choice Group
Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Subject: MATH
Name: Number Theory

Degree Attributes: Sac State BS Computer Science - Math/Logic Choice Group
Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Subject: MATH
Name: Introduction to Numerical Analysis

Degree Attributes: Sac State BS Computer Science - Math/Logic Choice Group
Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Subject: PHIL
Name: Deductive Logic II

Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Subject: STAT
Name: Intermediate Statistics

Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Subject: STAT
Name: Introduction to Probability Theory

Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).

Name: Introduction to Techniques of Operations Research

Requirement Rule: Choose one course from this group (3 units).
